commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/fix-rejected-original-retention
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "$BRANCH"
python3 -m pytest -q backend/app/tests/services/test_private_original_retention.py backend/app/tests/services/test_rejected_original_retention_state.py backend/app/tests/services/test_local_data_diagnostics.py
make PYTHON=python3 schema-check
git diff --check
git status --short
git add backend/app/services/media/images.py backend/app/services/photo_uploads.py backend/app/services/memory_uploads.py backend/app/api/routes/admin_photos.py backend/app/api/routes/admin_memories.py backend/app/services/media/redaction.py backend/app/services/private_original_retention.py backend/app/tests/services/test_private_original_retention.py backend/app/tests/services/test_rejected_original_retention_state.py
git commit -m 'Make rejected original retention database-consistent'
echo final_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
